geo_aeo.answer_first_block: NATS JetStream is a lightweight, ultra-high-performance event streaming engine written natively in Go. It serves as a compelling Kafka alternative by providing built-in persistence, Exactly-Once delivery guarantees, and multi-tenancy without JVM or ZooKeeper operational dependencies.
